FROM skills s JOIN skill_versions sv ON sv.skill_uuid = s.uuid AND sv.version = s.latest_version AND sv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND sv.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND s.external_id = #{skillExternalID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.latest_version IS NOT NULL AND s.latest_version <> ''
